arxiv-2106-02497.title: COINS: Dynamically Generating CO ntextualized I nference Rules for N arrative S tory Completion
arxiv-2106-02497.creator: Debjit Paul, Anette Frank
arxiv-2106-02497.description: Abstract Despite recent successes of large pre-trained language models in solving reasoning tasks, their inference capabilities remain opaque. We posit that such models can be made more interpretable by explicitly generating interim inference rules, and using them to guide the generation of task-specific textual outputs.

arxiv-2106-11516.title: SA-LOAM: Semantic-aided LiDAR SLAM with Loop Closure
arxiv-2106-11516.creator: Lin Li, Xin Kong, Xiangrui Zhao, Wanlong Li, Feng Wen, Hongbo Zhang, Yong Liu
arxiv-2106-11516.description: Abstract LiDAR-based SLAM system is admittedly more accurate and stable than others, while its loop closure detection is still an open issue. With the development of 3D semantic segmentation for point cloud, semantic information can be obtained conveniently and steadily, essential for high-level intelligence and conductive to SLAM.

arxiv-2209-01760.title: REQA: Coarse-to-fine Assessment of Image Quality to Alleviate the Range Effect
arxiv-2209-01760.creator: Bingheng Li, and Fushuo Huo
arxiv-2209-01760.description: Abstract Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) of User Generated Content (UGC) suffers from the range effect, which indicates that on the overall quality range, mean opinion score (MOS) and predicted MOS (pMOS) are well correlated while focusing on a particular range, the correlation is lower. To tackle this problem, a novel method is proposed from coarse-grained metric to fine-grained prediction.

arxiv-2309-09963.title: Power of quantum measurement in simulating unphysical operations
arxiv-2309-09963.creator: Xuanqiang Zhao, Lei Zhang, Benchi Zhao, Xin Wang
arxiv-2309-09963.description: Abstract The manipulation of quantum states through linear maps beyond quantum operations has many important applications in various areas of quantum information processing. Current methods simulate unphysical maps by sampling physical operations according to classically determined probability distributions. In this work, we show that using quantum measurement instead leads to lower simulation costs for general Hermitian-preserving maps.

arxiv-2311-06558.title: Convolve and Conquer: Data Comparison with Wiener Filters
arxiv-2311-06558.creator: Deborah Pelacani Cruz, George Strong, Oscar Bates, Carlos Cueto, Jiashun Yao, Lluis Guasch
arxiv-2311-06558.description: Abstract Quantitative evaluations of differences and/or similarities between data samples define and shape optimisation problems associated with learning data distributions. Current methods to compare data often suffer from limitations in capturing such distributions or lack desirable mathematical properties for optimisation (e.g. smoothness, differentiability, or convexity).

arxiv-2403-10933.title: Reduced Basis Method for the Elastic Scattering by Multiple Shape-Parametric Open Arcs in Two Dimensions Thanks: This work was funded by the ANID grant Fondecyt Iniciación N°11230248.
arxiv-2403-10933.creator: José Pinto †, Fernando Henríquez ‡
arxiv-2403-10933.description: Abstract . We consider the elastic scattering problem by multiple disjoint arcs or cracks in two spatial dimensions. A key aspect of our approach lies in the parametric description of each arc’s shape, which is controlled by a potentially high-dimensional, possibly countably infinite, set of parameters.

arxiv-2403-15202.title: Structure Formation in Various Dynamical Dark Energy Scenarios
arxiv-2403-15202.creator: Masoume Reyhani, Mahdi Najafi, Javad T. Firouzjaee, Eleonora Di Valentino
arxiv-2403-15202.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Masoume Reyhani, Mahdi Najafi, Javad T. Firouzjaee, Eleonora Di Valentino. This research investigates the impact of the nature of Dark Energy (DE) on structure formation, focusing on the matter power spectrum and the Integrated Sachs-Wolfe effect (ISW).

arxiv-2504-17862.title: Geodetic Set on Graphs of Constant Pathwidth and Feedback Vertex Set Number
arxiv-2504-17862.creator: Prafullkumar Tale
arxiv-2504-17862.description: Abstract In the Geodetic Set problem, the input consists of a graph G G and a positive integer k k . The goal is to determine whether there exists a subset S S of vertices of size k k such that every vertex in the graph is included in a shortest path between two vertices in S S .

arxiv-2508-20208.title: Removing atmospheric turbulence from ground-based astrometry with fast correlation function measurements
arxiv-2508-20208.creator: Daniel C. H. Gomes, Gary M. Bernstein, Claire-Alice Hébert
arxiv-2508-20208.description: Abstract We present a code that removes ∼ 90 % \sim 90\% of the variance in astrometric measurements caused by atmospheric turbulence, by using Gaussian process regression (GPR) to interpolate the turbulence field from the positions of stars measured by Gaia to the positions of arbitrary targets.

europmc-pmc5446558.title: What do parents perceive are the barriers and facilitators to accessing psychological treatment for mental health problems in children and adolescents? A systematic review of qualitative and quantitative studies.
europmc-pmc5446558.creator: Reardon T, Harvey K, Baranowska M, O'Brien D, Smith L, Creswell C.
europmc-pmc5446558.description: A minority of children and adolescents with mental health problems access treatment. The reasons for poor rates of treatment access are not well understood. As parents are a key gatekeeper to treatment access, it is important to establish parents' views of barriers/facilitators...

pmc-10604825.title: Overnight Melatonin Concentration and Sleep Quality Are Associated with the Clinical Features of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
pmc-10604825.creator: Adam T Evans, Heidi Vanden Brink, Jessica S Lim, Brittany Y Jarrett, Annie W Lin, Marla E Lujan, Kathleen Hoeger, Ebrahim Asadi
pmc-10604825.description: Circulating melatonin is elevated in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS); whether circadian disruptions coincide with sleep disturbances in women with PCOS or their symptom severity is unclear. The objective of this observational pilot study was to determine whether altered patterns of melatonin excretion are associated with reduced sleep quality in women with versus without PCOS.

pmc-11437868.title: High expression of PAX8-AS1 correlates with poor prognosis and response to fluorouracil-based chemotherapy in stage II colon cancer
pmc-11437868.creator: Hongsheng Fang, Lingyu Han, Yun Xu, Ruiqi Gu, Guoxiang Cai, Zuguang Xia, Weixing Dai, Renjie Wang
pmc-11437868.description: Highlights•We for the first time developed an integrated mRNA-lncRNA signature and unveiled the role of novel lncRNA PAX8-AS1 in guiding adjuvant chemotherapy in stage II colon cancer.•High expression level of PAX8-AS1 is firstly proved to be associated with early relapse and increased chemotherapy response of stage II colon cancer.

pmc-11535155.title: Cancer neuroscience at the brain–body interface
pmc-11535155.creator: Jeremy C Borniger
pmc-11535155.description: In this Outlook, Borniger discusses a view of cancer as a homeostatic challenge and how various cancers disrupt communication between the brain and body, leading to aberrant brain activity and accelerated disease; emphasizes cutting-edge work; and finally, addresses outstanding questions in the field.

pmc-11591430.title: A Biologic and Physical Characterization of an Injectable Amniotic Membrane Designed for Treating Diabetic Foot Ulcers
pmc-11591430.creator: Kimberly Velarde, Audrey Arvonen, Tatyana Gonzalez, Robert B. Diller
pmc-11591430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Globally, the health and quality of life of millions of people are negatively affected by diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs). To treat these chronic wounds, a novel injectable drug for closing DFUs composed of micronized amniotic membrane was developed. This new therapeutic drug for wound repair expands on traditional allograft therapies by allowing extracellular matrix proteins, growth factors, and cytokines to reach wound anatomies in DFUs that are difficult to treat.

pmc-12560583.title: Clinical characteristics of patients with COVID-19-associated mucormycosis (CAM) hospitalized at Shafa Hospital, Kerman: 2022
pmc-12560583.creator: Ayeh Shamsadini, Fatemeh Fakhrabadi, Darya Shamsadini, Shiva Pouradeli
pmc-12560583.description: BackgroundMucormycosis, commonly known as ‘black fungus,’ has emerged as a significant health threat during the COVID-19 pandemic, with a marked increase in prevalence among infected individuals. This study focuses on identifying the characteristics of COVID-19-associated mucormycosis patients in Kerman.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted at Shafa Hospital, Kerman, in 2022, following ethical approval from Kerman University of Medical Sciences.

pmc-12642335.title: Efficacy and safety profile of vortioxetine as an add-on molecule in obsessive-compulsive disorder: a randomized double-blinded placebo-controlled superiority trial – a study protocol
pmc-12642335.creator: Sucharita Mandal, Kaushik Mukhopadhyay, Aparajita Guin, Rupal Sorkhel, Pulama Mitra, Bisweswar Ojha, Kamini Verma, Sukriti Mukherjee
pmc-12642335.description: BackgroundObsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) affects approximately 2–3% of the global population and is associated with significant functional impairment and reduced quality of life. Despite its widespread impact, pharmacological treatments approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for OCD remain limited.

pmc-12788006.title: Maritime Small Target Image Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv11n
pmc-12788006.creator: Zhaohua Liu, Yanli Sun, Pengfei He, Ningbo Liu, Zhongxun Wang
pmc-12788006.description: Aiming at the problems of small-sized ships (such as small patrol boats) in complex open-sea backgrounds, including small sizes, insufficient feature information, and high missed detection rates, this paper proposes a maritime small target image detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv11n. Firstly, the BIE module is introduced into the neck feature fusion stage of YOLOv11n.

pmc-13242486.title: Reverse total shoulder arthroplasty is a surgical option for patients over 60 years of age with locked shoulder dislocation
pmc-13242486.creator: Emilio Sebastia-Forcada, Francisco Antonio Miralles-Muñoz, Daniel Martinez-Mendez, Luis Albero-Catala, Vicente Climent-Peris, Alejandro Lizaur-Utrilla
pmc-13242486.description: Backgroundin locked dislocation of the shoulder, instead of reducing back to the glenoid, the humeral head remains incarcerated on the glenoid in a locked fashion. This clinical situation is fairly uncommon. It is essential to conduct an individual evaluation of each patient to determine the appropriate treatment.

pmc-13372859.title: A unified necessary condition for dynamic bow snap-through with prestress tuning in electrostatically actuated bistable microbeams
pmc-13372859.creator: Sagi Tal, Lior Medina
pmc-13372859.description: A curved bistable microbeam, subjected to electrostatic loading from an electrode facing its concave side, may exhibit bow snap-through (BST) at nearly half the voltage (≈54%) when compared to actuation from the convex side. Previously, it was shown that introducing prestress can enable BST where it is otherwise unattainable.
